facts.text: The class is an RS-232 interface for ISEG high-voltage power supplies of the SHQ and NQH series
The CMDS table gives every command as one letter plus the channel and, for a setting, '=<value>'
A query echoes the command first and the answer follows on the next read; a different echo raises
The device reports '????' (syntax error), '?WCN' (wrong channel) and '?TOT' (timeout); the reader raises RuntimeError on them
get_voltage and get_current return the actual output voltage in V and current in A of the channel
get_source_voltage returns the target voltage in V and set_voltage sends the absolute value
set_voltage refuses a magnitude above the hardware voltage limit, which is a percentage of V_MAX
The module identifier is 'UNIT_NUMBER;SOFTWARE_REL;V_MAX;I_MAX' and V_MAX is its third field
V_MAX is returned by the module identifier, not held as a constant of the clone
The ramp speed is 1 up to and including 255 V/s
The answer delay is 1 up to and including 255 ms
get_autostart is True when the device answers '008' and set_autostart sends 8 for True and 0 for False
The channel must satisfy 1 <= channel <= n_channel, and n_channel comes from the init configuration
off() sets the output voltage to 0 V

operator_required.name: voltage_target
operator_required.reason: The maximum output voltage is the module's V_MAX, which the device returns in its identifier at run time (basil/HL/iseg_hv.py:486-487); no text in the clone states a fixed value for this module, so the operator supplies the site bound (site-limits.example.json shows the entry)

operator_required.name: channel
operator_required.reason: The channel count is the module's n_channel init setting (basil/HL/iseg_hv.py:83) and the check at line 249 bounds the channel to 1 <= channel <= n_channel; the clone states no value for this module, so the operator supplies the bound (site-limits.example.json shows the entry)

safe_state.description: the target voltage of the channel is set to 0 V (the upstream off() calls set_voltage(0))
